items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: he's the one who composed by Eh La Ba... But she didn't see, Eh La Ba don't go like that.

ctx.x: I never heard that. That's Louis Keppett, didn't you?

Louis Keppett, yeah. He was the one coming there, he was the first one who took a piece of sandpaper, he was playing guitar, and when they come to each party, he put the guitar down and take the sandpaper. That's why the sandpaper job got right behind me. Well that's enough, I'm tired now. I can't even think about more. Say. Oh yeah, but my bass. Now the bass I had, when I made, when I took a soapbox and put twine around it. And on a Monday was the Blue Monday, and people around there thought I used to laugh at…
